keyEvents.text: Goal! Liverpool 1, Brentford 0. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Mohamed Salah following a fast break.
Goal! Liverpool 1, Brentford 1. Kevin Schade (Brentford) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Ibrahima Konaté (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
